matches.rationale: Report finding 1 is the same defect: deposit forwards message.amount (lamports) to the treasury instead of the full wei amount.

Report finding 3 blames missing authorization of the withdrawer signer and treats the relayer account as hardcoded. It does not identify that the relayer account is unconstrained, which is the actual defect.
No report finding mentions that the withdrawal amount is not converted from lamports to wei.
No report finding addresses test coverage.
Report finding 6 names the missing non-zero check on message.recipient in EtherBridge.withdraw, which is one of the missing validations listed in this reference finding.
No report finding raises the nonce being marked as received only after the external call in receiveMessage.
